source_title: Auqib Nabi added to India squad for first three ODIs against New Zealand
source_excerpt: India have added fast bowler Auqib Nabi to their squad for the first three ODIs against New Zealand, bringing him into the group earlier than initially planned.The right-arm pacer was originally named in the squad for the fourth and fifth matches of the five-game series but will now be available from the opening ODI, starting November 4.The change comes after Prasidh Krishna was ruled out of the entire ODI series due to a hamstring injury sustained during the recent home series against the West Indies. His selection for the New Zealand tour had been subject to fitness clearance.Prasidh, however, remains in contention for the two-Test series against New Zealand. The pacer could be added to the India A squad for the third and final four-day match against New Zealand A, beginning November 7, if he clears his fitness assessment.Pace all-rounder Nitish Kumar Reddy will continue to be part of the ODI squad for the first match before linking up with India A for the third four-day game in Lincoln.
